posts.title: Traffic is the Best Editor
posts.description: TL;DR I’ve been working with generative AI across different tools for a while: Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Instinct, the works. posts.title: Seriousness Intended
posts.description: TL;DR If your default mode is jokes, people learn to read everything you say as a joke. That’s fine until the day you mean it. Have a serious hat, and make sure people know what it looks like before you need it. I’ve built a career on being the guy who lightens the room. Then one day, seriousness intended. posts.title: The Coffee Bit
posts.description: TL;DR Everyone has a coffee bit: the internal flag that says “sure, I’ll grab a coffee and hear what you’ve got”. People rarely leave because they hate the place. Things are fine, the bit flips, and nobody notices. A genuine “what’s up?” in every 1:1, continuous feedback and a visible ladder keep it at 0. I once had an excellent senior IC. Brilliant.
